DeleteAccount.title: Delete my account
DeleteAccount.deletedSignup: the e-mail and the intended use you wrote when signing up.
DeleteAccount.usageNote: The platform's usage records do not store who you are, so there is nothing of yours in them to erase.
DeleteAccount.irreversible: This cannot be undone. To use the platform again, you will need to sign up again.
DeleteAccount.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
DeleteAccount.failed: The account could not be deleted right now. Try again later.
DeleteAccount.askTeam: This account was created by the OCA team and may be used by more than one person, so it cannot be deleted here. To delete it, contact the team.
DeleteAccount.doneBody: Your account and your sign-up data were erased.
